title: Spicy Fasolada Stew
description: A hearty, spicy stew made with fasolada and a kick of jalapeno. This traditional Greek-inspired dish is perfect for a cozy dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the garlic and sauté for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the jalapeno and sauté for another minute.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add the fasolada, vegetable broth, salt, and pepper. Stir well.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or oregano if desired.
